annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulation binds owners (including operators) of automated vehicles, drivers of automated vehicles, and the Minister who must conduct an evaluation of the pilot project.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No person shall drive or permit the operation of an automated vehicle on a highway, except as permitted by this Regulation.
annotation.dates_quote: 18. This Regulation is revoked on October 13, 2027.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ONTARIO REGULATION 306/15 PILOT PROJECT - AUTOMATED VEHICLES
